## Description

Staff clock in and out on the clinic app. A missed or wrong entry is corrected by request and approved by an admin. A monthly attendance sheet exports as CSV.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A correction keeps the original entry and records who approved it.
- [ ] **AC2.** No location tracking; clock-in is from a signed-in clinic session only.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
